draft: I am writing to formally contest the electricity bill generated for my connection in Jaipur, which shows an amount of ₹7,850. My monthly electricity consumption typically results in a bill between ₹900 and ₹1,000. This sudden, excessive charge is unjustified. Upon reviewing the bill, I noted that it has been generated based on an 'average' reading rather than an actual meter reading. Furthermore, no meter reader visited my premises to record the actual consumption for this billing cycle. I request the department to verify the actual meter reading immediately and issue a corrected bill reflecting the true consumption. Please confirm the rectification of this error within 7 days. If this matter is not resolved satisfactorily, I will be compelled to escalate this grievance to the CPGRAMS portal.

To,
Department's public grievance officer / portal
Electricity Department

Date: 10 October 2026

Subject: Grievance regarding inflated electricity bill - Jaipur

Dear Sir/Madam,

I am writing to formally contest the electricity bill generated for my connection in Jaipur, which shows an amount of ₹7,850. My monthly electricity consumption typically results in a bill between ₹900 and ₹1,000. This sudden, excessive charge is unjustified. Upon reviewing the bill, I noted that it has been generated based on an 'average' reading rather than an actual meter reading. Furthermore, no meter reader visited my premises to record the actual consumption for this billing cycle. I request the department to verify the actual meter reading immediately and issue a corrected bill reflecting the true consumption. Please confirm the rectification of this error within 7 days. If this matter is not resolved satisfactorily, I will be compelled to escalate this grievance to the CPGRAMS portal.

Yours faithfully,
Alok
